description: This file defines a React component tree selector engine for querying React components and DOM elements based on React internal structures and attributes.

methods.name: getFunctionComponentName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name or 'Anonymous' for a React component function.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Determines the component name from a ReactVNode, supporting React 15 and 16+ structures.

methods.name: getComponentKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key of a ReactVNode.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Gets the children ReactVNodes of a ReactVNode, supporting React 15 and 16+.

methods.name: getProps
methods.description: Extracts props from a ReactVNode, removing 'children'.

methods.name: buildComponentsTree
methods.description: Builds a component tree from a ReactVNode, including root DOM elements.

methods.name: filterComponentsTree
methods.description: Filters a component tree based on a search function.

methods.name: findReactRoots
methods.description: Finds React root nodes in a document or shadow DOM, supporting React 15, 16+, and 17+.
